description: The hosted work tools `mesh mcp` calls on the platform's /mcp (tools/call over JSON-RPC, Bearer the person's own token) when its tools/list names all four: mesh_progress, mesh_ask, mesh_finish and mesh_release (mesh-cli ADR-023, Hosted path). Each entry is one tool: its name, the arguments mesh-cli sends — exactly these keys, no others, as runsheet's published input schemas name them (specs/contracts/runsheet/mcp-tools-*.json) — and an example of the text answer it relays to Claude Code. A refusal is the tool's result with isError true and the reason as its text; mesh-cli answers `<tool> refused: <text>`. mesh_progress and mesh_release name the job (job_id, today the item's id; runsheet ADR 069 step 3), mesh_ask and mesh_finish the item (item_id). mesh_claim is no MCP tool since runsheet ADR 069 step 3: the claim is always claimWorkItem, and a pair's join claims nothing. Once runsheet's /mcp no longer lists mesh_progress and mesh_release (ADR 069 step 4: they are the Mesh server's, which no person reaches), the hosted path is not served and the mutations are used. internal/meshmcp/hosted_test.go asserts the client sends these keys.

tools.name: mesh_ask

arguments.question: Should the test live in api/ or api/internal/?

tools.answer: asked; the answer comes back on the item
